name: @mnemosyne-plugins/mnemo-cosmos
description: An offline sky atlas wired to your own memory. Every star, cluster, nebula and galaxy on screen carries its catalogue identifier — HIP 32349, M31, NGC 224 — so you can ask what your own observing notes already say about the object you are looking at. Shows the sky for any instant and any place you name, with the Sun, Moon and planets at their computed positions, rise and set times, and the Moon's phase. Then it can quiz you: it hides an object's name, asks which one it is, and remembers when to ask again.

descriptionI18n.en: An offline sky atlas wired to your own memory. Shows the sky for any instant and any place you name, with the Sun, Moon and planets at their computed positions, rise and set times, and the Moon's phase. Then it can quiz you: it hides an object's name, asks which one it is, and remembers when to ask again.
descriptionI18n.fr: Un atlas du ciel hors ligne, branché sur votre propre mémoire. Chaque étoile, amas, nébuleuse et galaxie à l'écran porte son identifiant de catalogue — HIP 32349, M31, NGC 224 — pour demander ce que vos propres notes d'observation disent déjà de l'objet que vous regardez. Affiche le ciel pour n'importe quel instant et n'importe quel lieu que vous nommez, avec le Soleil, la Lune et les planètes à leur position calculée, les heures de lever et de coucher, et la phase de la Lune. Puis il peut vous interroger : il masque le nom d'un objet, demande lequel c'est, et retient quand vous reposer la question.
descriptionI18n.es: Un atlas del cielo sin conexión, conectado a tu propia memoria. Cada estrella, cúmulo, nebulosa y galaxia en pantalla lleva su identificador de catálogo — HIP 32349, M31, NGC 224 — para que preguntes qué dicen ya tus propias notas de observación sobre el objeto que estás mirando. Muestra el cielo para cualquier instante y cualquier lugar que indiques, con el Sol, la Luna y los planetas en su posición calculada, las horas de salida y puesta, y la fase de la Luna. Luego puede examinarte: oculta el nombre de un objeto, pregunta cuál es, y recuerda cuándo volver a preguntártelo.

agentActions.summary: Read what Cosmos shows: the instant, the place, where the sky is turned, the layers and the open object card
Find stars, deep-sky objects, the Sun, the Moon and planets by name or catalogue key
agentActions.details: Same search as the search panel: bodies first, then the brightest stars, then deep-sky objects, 40 at most. Keys look like HIP 32349, NGC 224; aliases like M31 or Sirius match too. Planets are found only while the planets layer is on.

text.description: At least 2 characters of a name, key or alias

limit.description: How many objects to answer, 1 to 40 (10 by default)

agentActions.summary: Open an object's card and turn the sky to it, as a search result does
agentActions.details: Takes a key (HIP 32349, NGC 224, M31) or a name as the person says it, in English, French or Spanish (Sirius, la planète Mars, la Lune, Saturno, nébuleuse d'Orion). Deep-sky common names are English (Andromeda Galaxy). Several matches are refused AMBIGUOUS with their keys. Refused while a review is open, because the sky is its question.

object.description: The object: its name as the person says it, or its key

agentActions.summary: Show the sky at another instant, or move the instant by some hours
agentActions.details: Give at (ISO 8601, 2026-08-12T21:30:00Z, or now) or shiftHours (negative goes back), not both. Years 1000 to 3000.

shiftHours.description: Hours to move the instant on screen by

agentActions.summary: Declare the place the sky is seen from, as the place form does, and keep it
agentActions.details: Altitudes, azimuths and rise and set times need a place. Nothing is geocoded: give the coordinates.

elevation.description: Metres above sea level (0 by default)

agentActions.summary: Turn the sky's layers on or off and set the faintest star drawn, as the controls panel does
agentActions.details: Only the layers given change. magLimit runs from 1 to the catalogue's own limit (status says it).

agentActions.summary: Zoom the sky in or out, set its field, centre it on the open object, or bring it back to its starting view
agentActions.details: reset wins over the others. zoom in halves the field, out doubles it. fov is the vertical field of view in degrees, 2 to 110: give zoom or fov, not both.

centreOnSelected.description: Turn the sky to the object whose card is open

agentActions.summary: Turn the sky to a constellation, wide enough to see its figure
agentActions.details: Takes its name in Latin, English, French or Spanish (Orion, Grande Ourse, Osa Mayor, Cassiopée) or its abbreviation (UMa). Answers whether the figures layer is on: turn it on with setLayers if the person wants to see the lines.

constellation.description: The constellation's name as the person says it, or its abbreviation

agentActions.summary: Open one of Cosmos's panels, as its button does: search, place (time and place), credits, or review (the quiz)
agentActions.details: text fills the search panel. Opening search or credits closes a review, as the buttons do.

text.description: What to type in the search panel

agentActions.summary: Close the object card, a panel or the review, as their close buttons do
agentActions.details: Without panel, closes everything open. Closing the review ends it on screen; answers already given stay saved.

panel.description: card (the object card), search, place, credits or review

agentGuide: Name an object or a constellation the way the person says it (« la planète Mars », « la Lune », « Sirius », « la Grande Ourse »): Cosmos finds it by its words, and a key (M31, HIP 32349) still works. Several matches are refused AMBIGUOUS with their keys: pick one and call again with the key.

To look at something: goTo for a star, a planet or a deep-sky object (its card opens); showConstellation for a constellation; setView zoom in or out to come closer or go wider; setView reset for the starting view.
Time: setTime shiftHours (« dans une heure » = 1, « demain » = 24, « hier » = -24) or at. Place: setPlace with the coordinates of the city the person names.
« Interroge-moi » / « quiz me »: showPanel review; the answers are given by hand in the review. closePanel closes the card, a panel or the review. While a review is open goTo is refused (REVIEWING).

fr: montre la constellation de la Grande Ourse
es: oculta los nombres de las estrellas
